summary: Gate verdict: proceed. followup-add-decision-choices-ledger carries the unshipped Phase 3 of the archived add-decision-choices-ledger change: three workflow hooks (iterate-on-implementation Step 11.5, validate-feature gate, cleanup-feature gate), two documentation updates, and one end-to-end fixture exercise. Outcomes are verifiable (proposal + WHEN/THEN spec delta + task breakdown with dependencies, sizes and per-task spec-scenario linkage; `openspec validate --strict` passes) and risk is low and fully reversible (skill-markdown and docs wiring around an already-shipped, tested, read-only audit driver; no schema, driver, DB, dependency or security surface touched).
completed_work: Read proposal.md, tasks.md, specs/skill-workflow/spec.md and loop-state.json for the change.

Cross-checked the archived parent at openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-10-add-decision-choices-ledger/ : its spec delta carries 4 requirements / 6 scenarios, so task 3.6's 'skill-workflow.1 through .8' reconciles exactly with those 6 plus the 2 scenarios carried forward here.
Verified design decisions D5 (cross-reference-only linkage) and D6 (non-blocking by construction) exist and remain readable in the archived design.md, so the task-level design references resolve.
Confirmed the proposal's central claim: 'Choices audit workflow integration' does NOT appear in openspec/specs/, so the canonical spec does not assert unimplemented behavior.

Confirmed the Phase 1/2 substrate the hooks depend on is present: skills/audit-choices/{SKILL.md,scripts/{run_audit.py,collect_evidence.py,choices_ledger.py}} and six test modules under skills/tests/audit-choices/.
Confirmed all five write targets exist: skills/iterate-on-implementation, skills/validate-feature, skills/cleanup-feature, skills/explore-feature, docs/guides/workflow.md.

decisions.rationale: Both gate axes are satisfied. VERIFIABILITY: has_proposal/has_specs/has_tasks are all true and the artifacts back the signals — the spec delta is WHEN/THEN, tasks.md preserves the parent's dependency graph (3.6 depends on 3.1/3.2/3.3) with sizes and scenario references, and two explicit checkpoints. Success is objectively checkable. RISK: gate_signals report no DB migration, no security signal, zero external deps and no broad write scope; the work edits skill instructions and docs around an existing read-only auditor whose spec mandates non-blocking behavior (D6, auditor exits 0 always), so a bad slice degrades to a logged no-op rather than a broken lifecycle. Every change is a git-reversible text edit.

decisions.decision: Verdict 'proceed' rather than 'proceed_with_review' (no extra VAL_REVIEW phase).
decisions.rationale: The standing safeguards are already proportionate to this blast radius: multi-vendor PLAN/IMPL review convergence, the VALIDATE phase, task 3.6's own end-to-end fixture exercise over all eight scenarios, the existing audit-choices test suite, and the mandatory human merge gate. An additional validation-review pass would add cost without addressing a residual risk this change actually carries.

decisions.decision: Noted one non-blocking artifact gap and let it pass to PLAN rather than escalating.
decisions.rationale: Task 3.3 (surface needs-user entries at the cleanup-feature gate) carries no '**Spec scenarios**' line, unlike its siblings 3.1 and 3.2. The behavior is covered by the requirement prose ('Validation and cleanup gates SHALL surface open needs-user entries ... they MUST NOT introduce a new blocking gate'), so it is verifiable, but it has no dedicated WHEN/THEN scenario. This is a symmetry gap in the carried-forward delta, best closed by plan review adding a third scenario — it is not a reason to stop for a human.

next_steps: Proceed to the PLAN phase for followup-add-decision-choices-ledger.

Ask plan review to consider adding a third scenario covering the cleanup-feature gate, mirroring 'needs-user entries surface at the validation gate', so task 3.3 gains the same scenario-level verification its siblings have.
Preserve the carried task numbering (3.1-3.6) and dependency edges during planning — keeping the parent change's graph intact is this change's stated purpose per the Selected Approach.
Hold task 3.6 until 3.1, 3.2 and 3.3 have landed; it is the only task with unmet in-change dependencies.
Treat the non-blocking contract (D6) as an implementation invariant to assert in review: no hook may turn an audit failure into a workflow stop.
